mila_csm: Heads-up — TesseraBio asked for a short-lived EU pin + CIDR allowlist for a partner showcase on Friday. They said demo quality impacts renewal discussion next week. Need ops + SRE to confirm safe caps and auto-revoke.

omar_sre: What are the exact CIDRs/headers, target burst, window, and tenant type? Hosted or Dedicated?

mila_csm: CIDR: 44.55.120.0/22 (partner edge). No special header. Current baseline RPS ~220. Request burst to 950 rps soft, hard 1200. Window: 2026-04-22T09:00Z -> 2026-04-24T21:00Z. Tenant: hosted (org: tessera-prod). EU-only routing preferred (eu-west2). TTL should be short (96h) and auto-revoke.

chiara_sales: Renewal risk = MEDIUM-HIGH until demo completes. Finance asked for an alert if we exceed soft ceiling. Will add to renewal tracker row.

omar_sre: Proposed plan:
- Create ephemeral CIDR allowlist entry name tessera-showcase-361999
- Per-org policy: soft-ceiling 950, hard-throttle 1200
- Region preference eu-west2, fallback eu-central1
- KV cache priming for top-25 prefixes 45m before start
- TTL 96h + auto-revoke; attach short rollback steps
Estimated short-term cost +9%-13% depending on cache warmup.

ops-runner: Internal apply commands (ops-only):
```
redwood-admin allowlist add --name tessera-showcase-361999 \
  --cidrs 44.55.120.0/22 \
  --org tessera-prod \
  --qps 950 --hard-throttle 1200 \
  --start 2026-04-22T09:00Z --end 2026-04-24T21:00Z \
  --region-preference eu-west2 --fallback eu-central1 \
  --ttl 96h --auto-revoke

redwood-admin cache prime --org tessera-prod --prefix-list top-25 --start 2026-04-22T08:15Z
```

config-bot: allowlist created (id: alw-92210) and rate policy applied (rp-90177). start=2026-04-22T09:00Z end=2026-04-24T21:00Z. Link: https://internal.redwood/allowlists/alw-92210

mila_csm: Thanks. Please add dashboard watch dashboard/tessera-prod/throughput -> alert @mila_csm @chiara_sales at 70% of soft and notify finance channel if soft breached. Also attach rollback steps to the allowlist page.

omar_sre: Watch added. Alerting set to 70% soft for @mila_csm and @chiara_sales; finance notified via #finance-alerts on breach. Rollback steps attached to alw-92210 (remove allowlist, revert rate policy, clear cache priming).

ops-runner: KV warmup job scheduled 45m prior. Will add a 2-step runbook to the allowlist page for on-call.

chiara_sales: I'll update the renewal tracker and tell TesseraBio the plan + auto-revoke details. We'll monitor and then reassess renewal risk after the demo.

mila_csm: Closing for now. I'll post a +1h and +end-of-demo usage snapshot. :white_check_mark:
